name: Watching Us
overview: Scripture reveals that God is attentively watching over His people, promising His continual presence and protection as seen in His assurance to Jacob that He will not leave until His purposes are fulfilled. The Psalms emphasize God's guidance and watchful care, portraying Him as one who instructs and keeps His eyes upon us. Ultimately, this divine vigilance is grounded in God's great love, demonstrated supremely through the giving of His Son to grant eternal life to all who believe.
